evidence: Authored uniform-format extension of existing scalar and aggregate I/O; no native aggregate formatting/layout proof

implemented.interpretation: One format list applied to every scalar using its own scalar domains; static compatibility across all member kinds and dynamic preflight
implemented.capture: READ selects all leaf references before format calls; WRITE detaches complete immutable scalar fields before format calls
implemented.effects: Width then second format once, before later source items; pause/resume retains captures; invalid source suppresses later format effects
implemented.input: Flat decoded callback/JSON batches, scalar TextInput parsing and remapped CR; waiting/cancelled transports retain atomic output contracts
implemented.output: Default or uniform formatting, one outer publication after rendering; no single scalar alignment metadata for mixed fields
implemented.binary: Existing width-only domains and explicit STRING/integral width override; no packed layout or NUL-trimming change
implemented.compatibility: Unformatted generated entry points retained; existing limits/protection/CONFIG/strict-mode boundaries unchanged

remaining: Missing input containers and partial/unknown output
Native layout/controller acceptance and strict mode
